summary: CR-076 full test run: Backend all 11 tests PASS. Frontend: 4/5 features PASS, 1 bug found in CampaignWizardPage audience pre-fill.

ui_bugs.issue: V5 BUG: When navigating to /campaigns/new?audience_stage=churned&audience_count=100, audience shows '0 customers' and Select shows empty. audienceId is set to lifecycle_stage:churned but (1) there's no matching SelectItem in the dropdown so nothing displays, and (2) audienceCount is reset to 0 by the audienceIdSync useEffect which runs after the prefill effect in the same render with audienceId='all-customers' (initial state not yet updated) and totalCustomers=0.

action_items: Fix CampaignWizardPage V5 pre-fill bug: audienceIdSync useEffect resets audienceCount to 0 when lifecycle_stage: prefix audience is pre-filled. Fix: add guard in audienceIdSync effect — if audienceId starts with 'lifecycle_stage:', skip the effect (preserve the count from URL param). Also add a read-only display item in the Select for lifecycle_stage: audience_id so the Select shows 'Churned Customers' instead of empty.

RCA: In CampaignWizardPage, the useEffect at line 169 has deps [audienceId, segments, totalCustomers]. On initial mount, it runs with audienceId='all-customers' (initial state, pre-fill hasn't committed yet) and totalCustomers=0, calling setAudienceCount(0). The pre-fill useEffect sets audienceCount(100) in the same mount cycle, but React's state update batching means the audienceId sync effect may run AFTER with stale values overriding the 100 with 0.
critical_code_review_comments: CampaignWizardPage.jsx L169-177: audienceIdSync useEffect has a race condition with the prefill useEffect. The prefill sets audienceId=lifecycle_stage:X and audienceCount=N but the audienceIdSync effect (which runs in the same render cycle) sees audienceId='all-customers' (stale initial value) and sets audienceCount=0, overriding the prefill. Fix: Guard with `if (audienceId.startsWith('lifecycle_stage:')) return;` at the top of the audienceIdSync effect.

CampaignWizardPage.jsx L407-414: The audience Select has no option for lifecycle_stage: prefixed IDs, so when pre-filled from URL params, the Select shows as empty. Should render a disabled/read-only option showing the lifecycle stage name when audienceId starts with 'lifecycle_stage:'.

rca_of_issue: CampaignWizardPage V5 pre-fill bug: React useEffect execution order issue. The audienceIdSync effect (deps: audienceId, segments, totalCustomers) runs in the initial render with audienceId='all-customers' (initial useState value) and totalCustomers=0, calling setAudienceCount(0). The prefill effect (deps: []) ALSO runs in the initial render and calls setAudienceCount(100). In React 18, both effects run in order after the same render — audienceIdSync first (line 169 is later in code than prefill at line 116, so actually prefill runs FIRST then audienceIdSync). Since audienceIdSync sees audienceId='all-customers' (not yet updated from prefill's setState) and totalCustomers=0, it calls setAudienceCount(0) which overrides the 100 set by prefill. Fix: add `if (audienceId.startsWith('lifecycle_stage:')) return;` to audienceIdSync effect.
